title: 224XL hall algorithm: Concert Hall and Room
about: Concert Hall (bank 1, program 1) and Room have this same shape: the same rows doing the same things, with different coefficients and delay offsets. The named rows were verified on Concert Hall. Rows are WCS rows (the program counter); program dumps number the same rows by step, 127 − row. The block anatomy and the named rows were read from the microcode and checked against this program's flow; the flow lens draws everything else from the loaded program itself.

blocks.name: Left input
blocks.text: The left ADC word into R0, times 26/32. Row 1 stores the RR saved by row 0's XFER, which holds the previous pass's last sum, not this input: the wiki's "starved branch" (row 126 in steps).

blocks.name: First tank lattice
blocks.text: Delay lines and 3-row allpass cells. Row 5 stores the left input history (W122); two of the four MID-decay cells sit here.

blocks.name: Cross-taps
blocks.text: Taps across to the other half and an RR capture.

blocks.name: B output builder
blocks.text: Builds output B (row 31, WR_DA B, carrying the direct MID decay coefficient) and stores a damping one-pole (row 32, W95, with the signed LOW − MID coefficient).

blocks.name: Diffusers + tap
blocks.text: Two lattice allpass cells (the DIFFUSION control) and the left FINPDL store (row 44).

blocks.name: A output mixer
blocks.text: Mixes output A (row 50, WR_DA A), the main left output. Rows 47 and 48 are PREECHO taps.

blocks.name: Second tank lattice
blocks.text: The mirror of the first tank. Row 56 stores the right input history (W71); the other two MID-decay cells sit here.

blocks.name: Cross-taps
blocks.text: Taps across to the other half.

blocks.name: D output builder
blocks.text: Builds output D (row 83, WR_DA D, carrying the direct MID decay coefficient) and stores a damping one-pole (row 84, W43, with the signed LOW − MID coefficient).

blocks.name: Two diffusers
blocks.text: Two lattice allpass cells (the DIFFUSION control).

blocks.name: C output mixer
blocks.text: Mixes output C (row 103, WR_DA C, also RESET), the main right output. Rows 99 and 100 are PREECHO taps; row 96 is the right FINPDL tap.

blocks.name: Last row
blocks.text: The row after RESET: the pass's last.

features.name: Outputs A, B, C, D
features.text: A and C are the main stereo pair; B and D are auxiliary (owner's manual v8.2 fig. 2.11).

features.name: Diffuser cell 1 (DIFFUSION)
features.text: Lattice allpass: tap × +12/32, store × 27/32, store × −12/32 (1 − g² ≈ 27.5/32).

features.name: MID decay cells (common)
features.text: Four 3-row allpass cells the MID DECAY control rotates (g = 13/32 here).

features.name: LOW − MID, signed (in the damping one-poles)
PREECHO taps 1–4
features.text: Level 0 at this setting: coefficient 0, so nothing uses the read.

features.name: FINPDL (final predelay), left and right
features.text: The control moves these two rows' offsets: row 44 (a store) and row 96 (a tap). It relocates the early returns rather than adding new ones.

features.name: CHO modulated tap pairs
features.text: Adjacent taps whose coefficients sum to 32/32: a fractional delay the firmware moves continuously (the CHO controller), so these rows change while the program runs.
